entities.summary: Christopher C. Summers is an American former professional ice hockey defenseman who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Arizona Coyotes and New York Rangers. He played out his career with the Thomas Sabo Ice Tigers of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL).
